principle: Universal soil/irrigation science packs; region/climate are tags only. Samples are illustrative literature notes — never auto-update FlahaSOIL algorithms.
handoffRule: Approved packs INFORM FlahaSOIL / CALC / FAST work. Product algorithm changes require a separate product process. Human review only (4S-B).

packs.title: Soil analysis thresholds baseline (sample)
packs.summary: Illustrative EC, pH, SAR, OM, and NPK-style notes for greenhouse and open-field systems. Universal science with place tags — not product defaults. 4S-B structured extracts.

items.title: Substrate EC upper note (tomato soilless)
items.bodyText: Illustrative literature-style note: many greenhouse tomato guides treat substrate EC above ~2.5–3.5 dS/m as elevated stress risk depending on stage and cultivar. Not a FlahaSOIL default.

items.title: Soil pH suitability band (most vegetables)
items.bodyText: Common agronomy guidance places many vegetables near pH 6.0–7.0 for nutrient availability. Calcareous arid soils often need different management — region tags, not product walls.

items.title: SAR caution band (illustrative)
items.bodyText: Elevated sodium adsorption ratio can degrade structure and infiltration. Treat values as literature orientation only.

items.title: Organic matter qualitative band
items.bodyText: Higher soil organic matter generally improves water holding. Arid open-field systems often start low.

structured.context: arid open-field illustrative floor, not universal optimum

items.title: Lab method — saturated paste EC
items.bodyText: Saturated paste extract EC is a common lab method for soil salinity comparison. Always record method with the number.

items.title: FlahaSOIL comparison workflow pointer
items.bodyText: Use COMPARISON_NOTE extracts and human review. Do not silently patch FlahaSOIL formulas from this pack.

packs.title: FlahaSOIL comparison notes (sample, human review)
packs.summary: 4S-B COMPARISON_NOTE extracts: literature orientation vs FlahaSOIL discussion. DRAFT until a human reviews. Never auto-applies to product code.

items.title: EC soilless tomato — literature vs product discussion
items.bodyText: Literature often flags substrate EC above ~2.5 dS/m as elevated risk for tomato. PA should compare against FlahaSOIL guidance bands manually; any product change needs a separate ticket.

structured.flahaSoilObservation: Human to fill after checking current FlahaSOIL defaults for soilless tomato.
structured.deviationSummary: Illustrative literature upper stress note may be tighter or looser than product defaults depending on crop stage and method.

items.title: pH vegetable band — calcareous arid context
items.bodyText: Literature 6–7 pH band for many vegetables; calcareous arid soils (QA/JO) often run higher. FlahaSOIL regional defaults must be reviewed by humans, not overwritten by this pack.

structured.flahaSoilObservation: Confirm whether product encodes arid calcareous adjustments as tags or hard defaults.
structured.deviationSummary: Universal 6–7 band may under-represent calcareous arid management practice; region tags needed in advice.

items.title: SAR structure risk — no auto-change
items.bodyText: If FlahaSOIL exposes SAR or sodium indices, compare against literature caution (~6 illustrative). Action is PA review or product ticket only.

structured.deviationSummary: Illustrative SAR caution only; product may use different indices (ESP, Na%).

items.title: Method pairing rule for any comparison
items.bodyText: Never compare literature EC to product EC without the same method identity (e.g. saturated paste vs 1:2 extract).

packs.title: Irrigation and water-saving context (sample)
packs.summary: Universal irrigation practice notes for PA advice paths (FlahaCALC / FlahaFAST later). Place tags only where climate/rules differ.

items.title: Drip irrigation uniformity check
items.bodyText: Periodic catch-can or flow checks help keep emission uniformity high.

items.title: Irrigation water EC caution (illustrative)
items.bodyText: Irrigation water EC above ~1.5–2.0 dS/m often needs salinity-aware scheduling for sensitive vegetables.

items.title: Equation note placeholder for FlahaCALC/FAST
items.bodyText: ETc = Kc × ETo backbone for irrigation advice. Pack stores identity only.

packs.title: Soil moisture × tomato context (sample)
packs.summary: Cross-cutting soil moisture notes for tomato under arid and greenhouse tags.

items.title: Avoid chronic water stress at fruit set
items.bodyText: Tomato fruit set and blossom-end rot risk rise under uneven moisture.

items.title: Reference — measure method with advice
items.bodyText: When citing moisture thresholds, always pair sensor/method with the number.

items.title: Moisture consistency vs FlahaSOIL advice tone
items.bodyText: If FlahaSOIL advice is stage-aware for tomato fruit set, confirm messaging stresses consistency over extreme dry-down in greenhouse arid climates.

structured.literatureRange: consistent moisture at fruit set preferred
structured.deviationSummary: Product tone should be checked for dry-down vs consistency messaging under arid greenhouse tags.
